listen_addr.description: Local IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the proxy to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4 interfaces, or :: for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Local TCP port number to listen on for incoming connections.

dest_host.description: Remote host (hostname or IP) to which traffic will be forwarded.

dest_port.description: Remote TCP port on dest_host to forward traffic to.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after binding to the port (must be an unprivileged user).

ipv4_enabled.description: If true, enable IPv4 support (listen and forward using IPv4).

ipv6_enabled.description: If true, enable IPv6 support (listen and forward using IPv6).

buffer_size.description: Size of internal read/write buffer in bytes (larger buffers may improve throughput).

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before closing a connection (0 = no timeout).

daemonize.description: If true, run as a background daemon process. If false, run in the foreground.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file (only used when daemonize=true). Set to empty to disable.

log_file.description: Path to the log file, or 'syslog' to use the system logger.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

extra_forwarding.description: List of additional forwarding rules. Each rule specifies a local address:port and remote host:port to proxy.

local_addr.description: Local IPv4/IPv6 address to bind for this rule.

local_port.description: Local port number to listen on (0 = use next available).
